item.title: Parmy Olson: The AI panic ignores something important — the evidence
item.description: Last week, a post written by tech entrepreneur and investor Matt Shumer went viral on social media. Titled “Something Big Is Happening,” it was a rundown of all the ways artificial intelligence would, in short order, decimate professional jobs.

item.description: The Robert H. item.title: The Optimist: Crosswords and ‘Godwinks’
item.description: It had been so long since I had a knish, I’d forgotten how they tasted. But it came back fast. When I saw them on the menu at the Jewish Food Festival at Nay Aug Park on a Sunday in late June, I ordered several along with schnitzel and corned beef sandwiches and one of my favorite foods ever, sweet noodle kugel. I brought it all home and invited my nephew Joe over to join in the feast. A 40-something, Joe is one of my best friends. His mom, who passed away a few years ago, was my wife’s sister.
